atoms.statement: Create SceneModel as a durable, per-camera persistence unit under runs/scene/<camera_id>/ with three subcomponents: background plate, spatial-normality grid, and furniture registry.
atoms.test: Verify `src/oko/memory/scene.py` exists, `SceneModel` manages subcomponents, and persists per-camera data.

atoms.statement: Persist SceneModel as separate versioned artifacts per component (background plate as .npy/.png, grid.json, furniture.json, meta.json) under runs/scene/<camera_id>/, written atomically via write-temp-then-rename with a schema_version field and tolerant loaders.
atoms.test: Verify `SceneModel.save()` creates versioned artifacts atomically and `SceneModel.load()` tolerates missing/old files.

atoms.statement: Background plate is per-cell EMA in steady state, bootstrapped by a short median over a small ring buffer during warmup, and every plate/grid update is GATED on the cell containing no active moving track.
atoms.test: Unit test background plate: verify median bootstrap, per-cell EMA update, and no updates when moving tracks are present.

atoms.statement: Implement a 16x12 spatial-normality grid that records, per cell, which YOLO classes are considered 'normal' based on confidence-weighted persistence over time.
atoms.test: Unit test normality grid: verify 16x12 grid accumulates confidence-weighted class persistence per cell.

atoms.statement: The furniture registry keys entries on a spatial+class signature (bbox IoU + YOLO class + persistence/hit-count over time), NOT on raw track_id, and only promotes a static track to 'furniture' after it persists past a threshold spanning the warmup.
atoms.test: Unit test furniture registry: verify entries are keyed by spatial+class signature and promoted only after persistence threshold.

atoms.statement: Modify events/builder.py minimally to expose or forward _static_track_ids to SceneModel instead of changing event semantics broadly.
atoms.test: Integration test: verify `_static_track_ids` are correctly forwarded from `events/builder.py` to `SceneModel`.

atoms.statement: Integrate SceneModel into pipeline/live.py at the VLM-gate decision point, not earlier in detector inference.
atoms.test: Integration test: verify `SceneModel` is called at the VLM-gate in `pipeline/live.py`.

atoms.statement: VLM-gate suppression in pipeline/live.py is FAIL-OPEN, active only in the READY warmup state, and requires BOTH conditions (furniture IoU-match AND ~0 plate-delta in the detection's cell); every suppression and every 'would-have-woken' case is counted in a shadow-mode metric.
atoms.test: End-to-end test: verify VLM-gate is FAIL-OPEN, active only in READY state, requires both conditions, and shadow metrics are logged.

atoms.statement: Implement a 2-5 minute warmup/bootstrap period during which the SceneModel initializes its components before VLM suppression becomes active.
atoms.test: Unit test warmup state machine: verify suppression is inactive for 2-5 minutes after initialization.

atoms.statement: Decompose Stage 1 into ~8 atoms — (1) SceneModel scaffold+persistence+versioning, (2) background plate, (3) 16x12 grid, (4) furniture registry, (5) builder.py feed of _static_track_ids, (6) SceneStore per-camera lifecycle, (7) warmup state machine + config flags, (8) live.py suppression hook + end-to-end project test — each with unit tests, grouped into chapters the architect reviews before assembly.
atoms.test: Process check: verify decomposition into listed atoms/chapters and architect review before assembly.

atoms.statement: Verification gates each atom on its own unit tests and gates chapter completion on the full bridge-projects/oko pytest suite plus a new synthetic end-to-end fixture (frames -> tracks -> SceneModel -> suppression decision); bridge-smoke alone is insufficient.
atoms.test: CI/CD check: verify unit tests run per atom, and full `pytest` with synthetic E2E fixture runs for chapter completion.

atoms.statement: SceneModel is a pure object (state + load/save, no I/O side effects in update paths); per-camera lifecycle (create/load/throttled-save) is owned by a separate SceneStore, and events/builder.py + pipeline/live.py only call thin read/feed hooks.
atoms.test: Unit test `SceneModel` for purity; integration test `SceneStore` for managing `SceneModel` lifecycle.

atoms.statement: Bound resource growth: fixed 16x12 grid per camera, capped furniture registry with LRU/persistence-based eviction, throttled saves (e.g. every N seconds or on warmup-state transition), and periodic compaction.
atoms.test: Load test: verify memory/disk usage remains bounded under long-running scenarios; unit test eviction/throttling logic.

atoms.statement: Capture and durably persist _static_track_ids from events/builder.py as a furniture registry, rather than discarding them per-event.
atoms.test: Integration test: verify `_static_track_ids` are captured from `events/builder.py` and durably persisted in the furniture registry.
